senses.gloss: m. (Parel of זנק, cmp. זִיקָא II) leather bag, hose.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 119:83">Targ. Ps. CXIX, 83</cite> (h. text <cite ref="N00008"><he>נֹאד</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 103b:10">B. Mets. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>דוולא וז׳</he> buckets and hose (for irrigation).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 58a:13">B. Bath. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ אמרה לכו</he> (comment. <he>זרונקא</he>, Ms. O. <he>זרקונא</he>, corr. acc.) she means a hose (which had been made of the hide of the animal stolen from her).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 167a:7">Ib. 167ᵃ</cite> <he>קם אז׳</he> (some ed. <he>אזרונקא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he wrote standing on a hose (to imitate a trembling hand-writing).—Pl. <he>זַרְניּקין</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 32:19">Targ. Job XXXII, 19</cite> Ar. (ed. <he>לגינין</he>, insert <cite ref="E00374"><he>היך</he></cite>).
